title: 动作 operation:'delete' 被拒时说明可行做法：用脚本动作或流程动作删除当前记录
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ② seat-found, objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 item E (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/5080#issuecomment-7207375342). Seat decides per the maintainer's standing word to the seat's threads (2026-11-27 01:51Z): 「这些问题你可以自己分析和拍板吧？」. No product or contract choice: refusal wording only.
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2 Build line).
Grading: area:ai · domain:spec · Task · p3 · size XS · reach: every author (agent or human) who tries a declarative delete action.
Dedupe: searched `operation: 'delete' refusal route`: none. Distinct from objectstack#37762 (skill text).

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：智能体想建「删除明细行」动作，写了 `operation: 'delete'` 被拒，拒绝信息没说该怎么做，它试两次就放弃了。
- 做法：拒绝信息里补一句可行做法：脚本动作删除当前记录，或流程动作。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Evidence
invoice r2 gave up on `delete_invoice_line` after two such refusals (3 pts lost); invoice r1, crm r2 and project ×3 built it as a script or flow action and passed.

## What to do
1. The `operation: 'delete'` refusal in the action row-update rule (packages/spec, "a row delete is the object's own delete affordance, not a declarative action") also names the working route: a `type: 'script'` action whose body deletes `ctx.recordId`, or a `type: 'flow'` action to an autolaunched flow (runs as the caller).
2. Update the message assertion in `action-row-update.test.ts`. Changeset (spec patch).
